text_block_list.text:
By chance, Хиши Амадзон catches Narita
Brian
and Симболи Рудольф together on a
partner run.
Their intensity has a strong
impact on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, she competes in a
scrimmage,
but her mind is still on Brian.
She loses the race,
immensely frustrated
by her shortcomings.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She yearns for the strength to compete
on Brian's
level, and decides that she'll
conquer the Triple
Tiara—just as Brian
takes on the Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And then finally, they'll have their
one-on-one at
the year-end Arima
Kinen. Goal in mind, Hishi
Amazon sets
her sights on the Oka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
